sections.h2: Net services and remittances together more than cover the goods deficit

chart.title: Services and remittances more than cover the $337.3bn goods gap
chart.sub: Balance of payments, FY2025-26, US$ billion.
chart.source: RBI, Developments in India's Balance of Payments, Q4 2025-26.

sections.means: Net services receipts of $216.6bn and remittances of $143.6bn together exceed the $337.3bn goods deficit.
sections.todo: Treat import substitution as balance-of-payments insurance while watching whether services receipts keep covering the gap.

sections.h2: AI has so far lifted India's business services exports, not cut them

chart.title: Business services exports sit 27% above their pre-AI trend
chart.sub: India's other business services exports, US$ billion.
chart.source: Richard Baldwin (IMD), analysis of WTO commercial services statistics, 30 July 2026.

sections.means: Other business services exports reached $185bn in 2025, up from $121bn in 2022, and 27% above the pre-AI trend.
sections.todo: Do not claim displacement has happened, since no measured export series shows it yet.

sections.h2: Net hiring fell from about 450,000 in FY22 to an estimated 135,000 in FY26

chart.title: Revenue keeps growing, but net hiring is far below its FY22 level
chart.sub: Net headcount additions, Indian IT industry, people.
chart.source: NASSCOM Strategic Review 2024, 2025 and 2026. FY2026 is an estimate.

sections.means: Industry revenue is expected to pass $315bn in FY2026 while net additions fell from about 450,000 in FY2021-22 to 135,000.
sections.todo: Watch revenue per employee and price realisation rather than headcount, which companies manage.

sections.h2: TCS alone drove a large net fall in headcount among the big five

chart.title: Only TCS shed a large number of staff; three of the five added people
chart.sub: Net change in headcount, FY2025-26, by company.
chart.source: Company filings (BSE; SEC Form 6-K). HCLTech headcount is press-reported.

sections.means: Infosys, HCLTech and Wipro added a combined 17,587 people in FY2026, while TCS's net fall of 23,460 drove the cohort's decline.
sections.todo: Watch the annual headcount figure rather than quarterly moves, since quarterly swings mislead.
